Lively rush cheers for the whole team
A month with airflow checks in mind
Steady care at Aurelia Skyways

I am sorry that our review still found room for refinement, yet the Companion Animal Travel Desk has kept its focus on clear guidance, calm handling, and respectful coordination for every traveler. Staff members have reinforced travel steps before departure, and the passenger coordinator has remained attentive to comfort, species needs, and the quiet details that help a journey feel orderly. <<FACT F022>> The team also continued to share practical notes with crews so that each handoff stays as smooth as possible.

Our monthly checks showed sound effort across the desk, though we urge continued care in every boarding area and holding space. <<FACT F012>> Even so, the overall tone has been encouraging, and the work reflects a sincere commitment to animal welfare. We remain grateful for the patience shown by travelers and staff alike, and we will keep improving with care and consistency.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
